name: The Lewd Deal
source:
The game has a single choice you make at the beginning that splits it into two routes, both of which have their own stories and lewd arcs that play out quite differently from each other.

Vanilla route (romance/seduction/story-focused): You are a single guy who is looking to buy a new home. You are about to meet Ashley, a lovely real estate agent, and tour a house with her. But everything is not as simple as it looks. It won’t be long before both of you find your selves in a situation you did not expect.

Fetish route (domination/corruption/threesome): You and your wife are looking to buy the dream family house. What the cute real estate agent Ashley is not aware of, however,is that you are not any ordinary couple, but a sexual power one that enjoys sharing, corrupting, and dominating together. Will Ashley be able to stand on her two feet, or will she submit to your desires?

[From [url=https://mrcreep-games.itch.io/the-lewd-deal-itch-version]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
开场时的一个选择，会把游戏引向两条路线。两条路线各自有独立的故事，情欲的发展也大不相同。

常规路线（侧重恋爱、诱惑与剧情）：你是个正在物色新居的单身男人，马上要见到可爱的房产经纪人阿什莉，跟她一起看房。可事情不像表面上那么简单。用不了多久，你俩就会陷入谁都没料到的境地。

特殊癖好路线（支配、堕落、三人行）：你和妻子想买一栋理想的房子安家。可爱的房产经纪人阿什莉并不知道，你俩绝非普通夫妻。你们爱在性关系中一同掌权，也喜欢分享、引诱和支配他人。阿什莉能坚持自己的立场，还是会屈从于你们的欲望？

（来源：[url=https://mrcreep-games.itch.io/the-lewd-deal-itch-version]itch.io[/url]）
